liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (2 reviews): Bird Song is singled out as outstanding; Bird Song is executed well enough, but Jerry seems briefly lost a couple of times [12][15]
- **Here Comes Sunshine** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it the most powerful Here Comes Sunshine ever, after searching other versions; Here Comes Sunshine has similar miscues, and the reviewer can't tell whether Bob or Keith's B-3 is audible [11][15]
- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Reviewer notes this show has the first performance of Let It Grow, though they hadn't yet heard it; Reviewer says this was the first ever Let It Grow [4][5]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): The jam closing Eyes of the World, on disc 3, is called truly insane; The Eyes of the World is also called powerful [7][11]
- **Other One Jam** (1 review): The Other One jam into Eyes is called one of the finest 25 minutes of Dead music [6]

## The recordings

- **gd73-09-07.aud-moore.weiner.18854.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 24 songs; 211 min; rated 4.75/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: This audience tape is said to capture the show's essence better than the soundboard; Reviewer finds soundboards from this era mix drums too loud and Jerry too low; For an audience tape, instrument separation is described as nearly perfect [9][12][13]
- **gd73-09-07.sbd.cotsman.19893.sbeok.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 181 min; rated 4.1/5 by 20 [2]. Said about its sound: Keith's keyboard tone stands out in places on this matrix; Keith's B-3 organ is clearly audible on several songs [5][15]
- **gd1973-09-07.sbd.goodbear.1126.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 24 songs; 177 min; rated 4.18/5 by 11 [3]

## Around the show

- These two Nassau nights opened the fall tour [8]
- Some crowd members repeatedly shouted requests for Me and My Uncle [13]
- Recommended to fans of the pre-hiatus Eyes versions; the rest of the show is sloppier, with some nice moments [7]
- They are the only September 1973 shows played without the horns [8]
- Reviewer recommends the 9/11 and 9/21 shows for playing quality among the September dates [8]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-09-07.aud-moore.weiner.18854.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Jerry Moore; transferred by John Steinthal; source: Audience Recording [1]. Also: Jerry Moore taped it with an AKG 1000 microphone into a Sony 110 cassette deck; Transfer chain: cassette played on TASCAM 112MKII to Sony PCM-500 DAT, then CD, secure EAC extraction, and SHN; Noah Weiner added the Moore audience recording to etree [1]
- **gd73-09-07.sbd.cotsman.19893.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard with audience patches [2]
- **gd1973-09-07.sbd.goodbear.1126.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Goodbear; source: Sbd, Reel M->Cass 1->Dat 0 -> DAT 1(?) -> CD, [3]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_36.html) [17]
